software_observation.reviewer: Codex host auditor; native API and decoded-media evidence

native_delivery_track_graph.foreground: lossless qtrle movie with straight alpha on V2

decoded_replay.method: All decoded 8-bit BGR pixels; no resizing or time realignment

actual_source_composite_diagnostic.method: Decode actual lossless RGBA movies; confirm their supplied PNG frames match; compare real native output against linear-light and sRGB-code-value alpha compositing over public pure green.
actual_source_composite_diagnostic.limitation: Residual error includes native H.264 compression and 4:2:0 chroma resampling. This is a software-pipeline diagnostic, not the quality-score calibration or a newly rendered background-change test.

limitations: The internal Lua bridge automatically reached its three-hour lifetime after both native replays. Further background-change and synthetic blend tests were not executed. The expired queue was retired with STOP to prevent replay.

ACEScg is recorded as the managed timeline space, but actual soft-edge color diagnostics do not conclusively distinguish linear-light from code-value blending after the native pipeline. Linear-light compliance remains unverified.
The trial included transport and duplicate-execution infrastructure fixes; it is not a clean frozen-environment model comparison.
software_observation.summary: 两段 DRP 交付时间线已导入独立工程并重链接到冻结素材；重新渲染的各 100 帧与原交付逐像素完全一致。工程包含独立绿底和真实 RGBA 前景轨道。线性光合成尚未得到充分验证；桥接到达三小时上限后，附加换底及合成探针未执行，因此完整软件合规保留为待核实。

previous_attempt_and_retry.reason: Repeated model request upload timeouts after a transient DNS outage; 10 MB probe succeeded with larger timeout.
